projects.title: Meteor - "Airline Seat Style" Room Selection
projects.description:
This was our senior project, a capstone project where Software Engineering students work with a real client in the industry. Our client was StarRez, "a world leader in providing student housing software." Our team's presentation was ranked 4th out of the 19 teams that presented to the department faculty.

• Met final release goals after 12 biweekly sprints
• Completely removed heavy, upfront data fetching by leveraging Angular 2’s robust asynchronous web requests (via migration from ASP Razor to Angular)
• Reengineered ASP.NET’s highly coupled MVC structure to only exposing web API endpoints
